LESSON: PRANAYAM

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pranayam. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: hown 1. What is “Pranayama”?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate the correct (6 lessons) simple breathing exercises for good health
2. perform simple breathing exercises to become spiritually and physically fit 83
3. appreciate breathing exercises as a way of coping with emotions.
4. demonstrate appropriate 1.2 Asanas (Body Postures)
5. practice of Pranaam asana, (6 lessons) for physical wellbeing
6. appreciate asanas for self- discipline and focus.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate the correct (6 lessons) simple breathing exercises for good health
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate the correct (6 lessons) simple breathing exercises for good health. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. perform simple breathing exercises to become spiritually and physically fit 83
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform simple breathing exercises to become spiritually and physically fit 83. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate breathing exercises as a way of coping with emotions.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate breathing exercises as a way of coping with emotions. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. demonstrate appropriate 1.2 Asanas (Body Postures)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate appropriate 1.2 Asanas (Body Postures). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

5. practice of Pranaam asana, (6 lessons) for physical wellbeing
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice of Pranaam asana, (6 lessons) for physical wellbeing. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

6. appreciate asanas for self- discipline and focus.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate asanas for self- discipline and focus. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pranayam.
2. Explain Pranayam to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pranayam.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate the correct (6 lessons) simple breathing exercises for good health
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pranayam. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: hown 1. What is “Pranayama”?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate the correct (6 lessons) simple breathing exercises for good health
2. perform simple breathing exercises to become spiritually and physically fit 83
3. appreciate breathing exercises as a way of coping with emotions.
4. demonstrate appropriate 1.2 Asanas (Body Postures)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
